item.title: RBI raises interest rates, hikes FY27 growth forecast by 40 bps and inflation by 20 bps
item.description: In a notable move, the Reserve Bank of India has adjusted the repo rate, increasing it by 25 basis points to 5.50%. This adjustment comes in response to stronger-than-anticipated economic growth alongside rising price pressures. Additionally, the RBI has updated its FY27 GDP growth prediction to 7.1%, indicating optimistic economic performance. Meanwhile, inflation forecasts have been revised upwards, predicting Consumer Price Index inflation to hover around 5.8%.
item.dc:creator: MAYUR SHETTY

item.title: ‘History will be kinder to you’: Gautam Gambhir bids farewell to Ajit Agarkar
item.description: Gautam Gambhir expressed his gratitude to Ajit Agarkar after Agarkar's tenure as chief selector ended. During Agarkar's time, India achieved significant success in ICC tournaments, including three trophy victories. Pragyan Ojha has been appointed interim chairman of selectors while the BCCI invites applications for a permanent replacement. VVS Laxman will be present at future selection meetings to improve communication with the Centre of Excellence.
item.dc:creator: PRANAV SHUKLA

item.title: Mercedes, 5-star hotel, hockey sticks: Nagaland woman's Delhi night out turns violent
item.description: A 28-year-old woman from Nagaland reported harassment and assault involving her friends at The Ashok hotel. The incident took place during the early hours of October 4, when two groups clashed in the parking area. The woman alleged that men in a car tried to abduct her and attacked her friends with hockey sticks. Police collected evidence, including blood samples, while no arrests were made so far.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Bill Gates once again calls for tax on robots, this time to save blue-collar jobs
item.description: Bill Gates has reiterated his call for taxing robots to counter the potential job displacement caused by AI. He believes this tax should be equivalent to FICA contributions made by human workers. The revenues generated from this tax would provide a safety net for citizens and support retraining initiatives. Other tech leaders are also advocating for similar tax policies to address AI-driven economic changes.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: CJP announces 'Chappal protest' in Bengaluru; actor Prakash Raj to join stir
item.description: On October 8, the CJP will conduct a 'Chappal protest' at Freedom Park in Bengaluru. The protest follows a People's Tribunal discussing the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls. Civil society groups are concerned about voters being incorrectly removed from the list. They are demanding that deletions from the SIR be reversed and that the electoral rolls from before SIR be retained.
item.dc:creator: HADI KHAN

item.title: Man’s VRS Rs 65.21 lakh payout taxed as salary; ITAT Pune says it is capital receipt
item.description: The man had been employed in Aurangabad. During FY 2018-19, his employer shut down its Aurangabad plant and introduced a financial scheme for its employees. The man opted for voluntary retirement under the scheme and received a total payment of Rs 65,21,105. The amount consisted of ex-gratia/severance pay, early bid and group participation incentives, and payment towards the notice period.
item.dc:creator: TOI BUSINESS DESK

item.title: From parents' struggles to 'endless coffees': How Savitha won India's only gold medal
item.description: In the final installment of TimesofIndia.com's series looking back at India's medal-winning campaigns at the Chess Olympiad in Samarkand, Savitha Shri opens up about her remarkable breakthrough as India's only individual gold medallist. The 19-year-old recalls arriving as a reserve, playing all 10 rounds and delivering when India needed her most, while discussing her family's sacrifices, the team's bronze, Swayams Mishra's support and her goal of becoming a Grandmaster.
item.dc:creator: JYOTIRMOY HALDER

item.title: 'They paid Rs 300 only': How payment dispute turned deadly for elderly couple
item.description: Ramesh Kapoor, his wife Rajni, and their house help Tilya Devi were found murdered in Dehradun. The couple had an argument with plumber Raj Kumar over payment for work done. During the altercation, Raj Kumar attacked the couple and fatally stabbed Tilya Devi when she intervened. A screwdriver was recovered at the crime scene and is believed to be the murder weapon.
item.dc:creator: KALYAN DAS

item.title: Michael Douglas and Catherine Zeta-Jones’ Hudson River estate lists for $9.75m
item.description: After extensive renovations, Michael Douglas and Catherine Zeta-Jones are reintroducing their magnificent Hudson River estate, Longmeadow, to the market at $9.75 million. Originally acquired for $4.5 million in 2019, this sprawling property encompasses nearly 12 acres, boasting a stately Georgian-style mansion adorned with luxury features. As their family dynamics evolve post their children's departure, the couple decides it's time for a change, despite previous price adjustments.
item.dc:creator: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK

item.title: New York woman found painting in trash; 4 years later, it sold for $1.049m
item.description: In 2003, Elizabeth Gibson found a brightly coloured painting in the rubbish on Manhattan’s Upper West Side. She later discovered it was Rufino Tamayo’s 1970 work “Tres Personajes”, stolen from a Houston couple in 1987. Sotheby’s planned to auction it for up to $1 million.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Apple founder gave $1.8m to children's museum that has already seen 10M visitors
item.description: Steve Wozniak contributed $1.8 million to the establishment of the Children's Discovery Museum of San Jose. The museum opened in 1990, focusing on hands-on learning and interactive exhibits for children. With more than 150 exhibits, it covers various educational themes in science and the arts. Over 10 million visitors have explored the museum since its inception. The institution continues to enhance learning through exploration and play over three decades later.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Texas court lets oil company cross 1,604-acre ranch to plug shut-in well
item.description: In a significant ruling, a Texas appeals court has granted Allegiant Resources the right to enter McFaddin Ranch to seal an inactive well. This decision comes in response to environmental concerns linked to the well’s proximity to the San Antonio River. Earlier access via another ranch was lost, emphasizing the intricate regulatory landscape governing inactive oil wells and the access issues surrounding private land ownership.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: 3 tennis players killed, 3 injured after car rams truck on Purvanchal Expressway
item.description: Three tennis players lost their lives after their car collided with a truck on Purvanchal Expressway. The incident occurred under Baldirai police station area on Wednesday afternoon. Police suspect that the driver may have fallen asleep at the wheel, causing the crash. The injured victims were quickly transported to a nearby hospital for medical treatment.
item.dc:creator: SHREEDHAR RATHI

item.title: Harmanpreet's captaincy: 211 matches, one WC and a debate that never went away
item.description: From a stand-in captain in 2012 to India's first women's ODI World Cup-winning skipper, Harmanpreet Kaur's 14-year captaincy produced 211 matches, 126 wins and eight title or gold-medal finishes. It also brought repeated questions over her leadership, batting and record against Australia. Her resignation closes a captaincy era that delivered the trophy India had waited for, while leaving the T20 World Cup and a long-running succession debate finally resolved.
item.dc:creator: VINEET RAMAKRISHNAN

item.title: From Shakti to Aravalli: India's helicopter engine journey takes shape
item.description: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh inaugurated a second production line for Shakti helicopter engines at HAL's Koraput division. This facility is expected to be fully operational by 2028-29 and will produce up to 100 engines annually. HAL is also increasing the production capacity of AL-31FP engines for the Su-30MKI to support aircraft operations. The Shakti engine development exemplifies India's progress in aerospace technology and indigenous manufacturing capabilities.
item.dc:creator: DHRUV YADAV

item.title: Sick leave approved, but SBI declared his job ‘voluntarily vacated’: Why HC stepped in
item.description: In a significant ruling, the Patna high court reinstated a State Bank of India employee who was wrongly deemed to have abandoned his role after taking medical leave for health issues. The court highlighted the bank's failure to appropriately manage his medical documents, ultimately reinstating him without pay for the duration of his absence. This case underlines the critical importance of adhering to employment protocols.

item.title: Grandfather shoots grandson dead: How blood splatters exposed killing in Lonavla
item.description: Abhay Marathe, a 33-year-old lawyer, was found dead from a bullet injury in Lonavla. His family initially claimed the shooting was accidental while he cleaned his grandfather's rifle. However, police investigation revealed inconsistencies and evidence of a dispute over property. Abhay's grandfather Motiram Marathe has been charged with murder, and four relatives are accused of destroying evidence.

item.title: Opposition's anti-SIR-CEC march turns into INDIA bloc-government face-off
item.description: Opposition members from the INDIA bloc, led by Rahul Gandhi, organized a protest march to the Election Commission. The police stopped their march just before reaching Akashvani Bhavan, leading to a lengthy dharna by the MPs. Despite police attempts to remove the protesters, several MPs entered the Akashvani premises and continued their demonstration. Rahul Gandhi criticized Prime Minister Modi and accused his government of treasonous actions against the country.

item.title: Astronomers find ‘phoenix planet’ born from ashes of a dying star
item.description: A team of astronomers has discovered a second-generation planet orbiting a white dwarf named HS 0209+0832. This planet formed from the material that the white dwarf expelled during its death. The atmosphere of the white dwarf contains heavy elements such as zinc, copper, and niobium. This discovery could change the way astronomers search for similar planets around dead stars.
item.dc:creator: SURENDRA SINGH

item.title: 13 Navy personnel under scanner in Pakistan-linked espionage probe
item.description: A significant counter-intelligence operation named 'Operation Firewall-2026' is underway across multiple states in India. Eighteen individuals are being investigated for their suspected connections to an espionage network linked to Pakistan. Among the suspects, 13 are reported Navy personnel, and electronic devices have been seized during searches. Two individuals have already been arrested for allegedly leaking sensitive information related to the Indian Navy.
item.dc:creator: VENU LANKA

item.title: Messi's emotional farewell ends in 1 goal, 2 assists and 3-0 win for Argentina
item.description: Lionel Messi’s emotional Argentina farewell ended in a 3-0 victory over Benin at the Monumental. After an extraordinary pre-match tribute, Messi assisted Nicolás Otamendi’s opener and Nico Paz’s curling finish before scoring a penalty himself. He came close again late on, hitting the post, before sending a final free-kick over the bar as Argentina celebrated a memorable night.
item.dc:creator: JYOTIRMOY HALDER

item.title: 'Why 60% enriched fuel?' Vance demands Iran cut nuclear capacity to end war
item.description: US vice president JD Vance emphasized that Iran needs to make significant reductions in enrichment capacity. Vance highlighted the necessity of actionable commitments rather than mere promises for negotiations. The US is uncertain about Iran's internal decision-making process, especially after recent significant events. As the conflict continues, it poses political challenges for the Trump administration ahead of the midterm elections.

item.title: CBI raids CM Bhagwant Mann’s camp office, his OSD’s home in graft probe
item.description: CBI conducted raids on multiple locations including the camp office of Punjab CM Bhagwant Mann. The investigation stems from a High Court order based on allegations from the Enforcement Directorate. Various individuals are named in the FIR for their alleged involvement in corruption and manipulation of government processes. Mann criticized the timing of the raids as politically motivated amid upcoming elections.

item.title: Ronaldo reveals 'truth' he promised, details coach Jesus’ betrayal in damning statement
item.description: Cristiano Ronaldo has revealed why he left Portugal’s camp, claiming Jorge Jesus broke promises over his playing time and then contradicted their private agreement publicly. Ronaldo said the situation left him feeling unwanted and that continuing would harm the team. He apologised for leaving, accepted responsibility for his actions and insisted he remains available to compete for Portugal after his suspension.

item.title: Jason Sanjay recalls college romance; Thalapathy Vijay's son opens up on breakup
item.description: In a candid revelation, Jason Sanjay, son of the iconic Thalapathy Vijay, reflects on the trials of his college romance, which ultimately succumbed to long-distance challenges while he pursued studies abroad. Music became his solace during the emotional turbulence, particularly the melodies of Yuvan Shankar Raja. To respect his past relationship, Sanjay refrained from sharing sentimental posts on social media.
item.dc:creator: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK

item.title: Flydubai cockpit attack left Capt Smit Machchhar with 'depressed skull fracture'
item.description: Captain Smit Machchhar faced serious injuries from his co-pilot during the flight's crisis situation. The co-pilot attacked him with an axe, resulting in a skull fracture that required emergency surgery. Doctors monitored his recovery closely and assisted him for further treatment in the UAE. The Indian embassy is providing support to Captain Machchhar and his family during this challenging time.
item.dc:creator: TNN
